domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403, tofler.in returned HTTP 404, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) during this session. Domestic supply therefore not verified from a primary record — null, not inferred.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by customs bill-of-lading records with dates, HS codes and B/L numbers, not by website claims: regular shipments of own formulations (FEVASTIN IV 100ML, HAPENZ SYRUP, BIFILAC DRY SYRUP) to Nepal via Raxaul/Birgunj, latest seen 2026-02-09, plus sample consignments. The same customs data also shows the company as an importer of APIs/excipients (5-HYDROXY ANTHRANILIC ACID HCL from Japan, UREX CBLEND-45 probiotics from Chr. Hansen Denmark, empty glass bottles from France) and of unrelated goods (Swarovski reflective glass beads), consistent with a real manufacturing operation at No.179, T.H. Road, Tondiarpet, Chennai — note the claimed state 'Maharashtra' does not match the customs address in Tamil Nadu. Declared HS 300490 is broadly consistent with the observed 30049011/30049069/30049070 lines, so no HS correction is needed; the industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is imprecise (pharma manufacturer). Domestic Indian-market supply: no trace found in accessible sources, status unknown rather than 'none_found' because the registries were blocked, not empty. Revenue: null — not public in the sources reachable here.
